title: 山腰刀兵，段聿铠闯峰
purpose: 承接 SC14 后院藏身：白衣女子与拓拔野各怀心事；半山腰忽起刀兵，朝阳谷众人色变；浑身鲜血的段聿铠跃上竹楼公开挑衅青帝；十四郎转身向禁院请战。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成字幕、门额文字、咒骂台词文字或任何可读文本。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 anchors to the previous hidden courtyard storyboard for the split bamboo layout and mood. SH02 anchors to the previous arrival storyboard for courtyard plus distant external pressure. SH03 anchors to Duan Yukai turnaround/basic identity reference. SH04 anchors to the previous hidden courtyard storyboard to preserve gate, bamboo, and hidden observer positions.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, battle cries, insults, music, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 他这般难过，是因为想起神帝了吗？

十四郎恳请青帝准许十四郎将这狂徒拿下。
